svg.title: Container terminal vessel call: discharge, then load
svg.desc: Animated cross-section of a semi-automated container terminal at night. An STS crane discharges four blue import containers from the vessel onto AGVs, which carry them to an automated stacking crane in the yard. Then four orange export containers travel the other way and are loaded on board. The ship sails, the next call berths, and the cycle repeats. A TOS status bar tracks each move.
